deploymentRecommendation.choice: C. Deploy with release notes only
deploymentRecommendation.rationale: Direct Case Builder pair frequency analytics are unavailable, and observed affected-code search interest is low. The release is calculation correctness, not a UX-breaking workflow change; warning-card behavior has already been validated. A banner would overstate the expected user-visible blast radius.
